text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rawr! I am the King of Evil, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of ya! Keep your eyes 
glued to Windy-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll win a ton and hog everyone's 
attention all to myself! Wahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
